capabilities: Sync config folder contents to a common folder
Restore config folder contents from the common folder
Configure the common folder with a relative or absolute path
disambiguation: It does not sync a vault across devices itself; it only copies the config folder to a normal folder for use with the user's own sync tools.
extras: The README is bilingual (English and Chinese).
motivation: The author built it because the config folder must start with a dot and some sync tools used do not support syncing dot-prefixed folders.
problem: The Obsidian config folder must start with a dot, and some sync tools do not sync dot-prefixed folders, leaving the configuration unbacked-up.
summary: Copies the dot-prefixed Obsidian config folder to a normal folder (and restores it) so external sync tools that skip dot-folders can back it up.
